title: Run it for two weeks without escalation
why_matters: Anyone can deliver the first iteration with adrenaline. The second and third iterations — when the novelty has worn off and nobody's watching — are where ownership actually lives. Run your new recurring activity for two clean weeks before declaring it owned.
steps: Plan iterations two and three of your new responsibility. Calendar them.
Do each one to the same standard as the first.
Resist the urge to ask your previous owner whether you're doing it right. Either ship it and ask for feedback after, or trust your read.
After iteration three, write a one-paragraph note on what you'd change about how the activity is structured. You're not just doing it — you're improving it.
success_criteria: Two further iterations have shipped. No escalation has been needed. A one-paragraph note exists with at least one structural improvement you'd propose.
reflection_prompt: What were you tempted to escalate that turned out to be solvable on your own?
